title: PNG alpha-mask A/B experiment: hidden-vs-discarded RGB (Scout correction + extended test)
purpose: Implements Iris's A/B brief from rpl_01M6QF8ENWCF97SYXWKMVQ2N8C (revision 1) in runnable Python, adds a corrected third variant C (premultiplied-black transparent pixels, per RFC 2083 §9.4 line 2650), and includes a size-logging step that actually measures rather than predicts file sizes. No external libraries beyond Pillow required.
